11: Grounded in the six foundations of Lifestyle Medicine: nutrient-rich food, purposeful movement, restorative sleep, mental and emotional balance, meaningful connection, and avoidance of harmful substances, our approach empowers you to feel better, function better, and flourish at every age.
17: We offer a hybrid model: schedule assessments in our space, and join group sessions and follow-ups virtually if more convenient. However, for optimal outcomes, we do recommend attending sessions in-person whenever possible.
21: Move with purpose, live with vitality. Physical activity is more than exercise. It's a daily act of self-respect that strengthens both body and mind. Whether it's structured training or mindful movement in everyday life, our tailored approach meets you where you are. Through accessible, sustainable routines, from gentle mobility work to resistance training and cardiovascular conditioning, we guide and support your ability to move freely, age gracefully, and experience the uplift of motion. Every step, stretch, or breath becomes a tool for longevity and resilience.
24: Heal in community. Human connection is one of the most potent predictors of lifelong health. Whether through family, friendships, group programs, or shared meals in our cafe, we help you strengthen the relationships that uplift and sustain you. Social ties not only buffer stress and reduce risk of disease, they create meaning, purpose, and joy. At Curate Health, you're not just supported. You belong.
25: Find calm in the current. In a fast-paced world, the ability to regulate stress becomes an essential skill in preserving health. We offer evidence-based practices, such as mindfulness, psychotherapy, breathwork, meditation, and nervous system regulation, to help you cultivate inner steadiness. These tools support resilience, reduce inflammation, and enhance clarity, allowing you to meet life's challenges from a grounded, centered place. Over time, stress becomes less a threat, and more an invitation to deepen your connection to self.
26: Just as a building relies on a solid foundation, your body's wellness depends on the health of your spine and joints. With intricate knowledge of anatomy, physiology and biomechanics, our chiropractors bring a master builder's touch to your body's blueprint, ensuring that every part of your skeletal structure, from the ground up, is moving at its best. Imagine the joy of being able to do the things you love, with more optimal body function, free of nagging aches and pains.
27: Navigating life with back pain, neck stiffness, or joint discomfort can feel like living in a home that's constantly under construction, where there's always something out of place, causing discomfort and preventing you from enjoying your day fully. At Curate Health, we see chiropractic care as the skilled architect your body needs to restore its structural integrity and harmony.

37: Curate Cafe is more than a place to grab a drink or meal. It's a space to savor, reflect, and realign with your well-being. Here, quality is savored, wellness is honored, and sustainability is simple. We look forward to welcoming you in, sharing a cup, and helping you make every bite a step toward feeling your best. Our in-clinic menu changes seasonally, reflecting the freshest ingredients available and keeping your healthy eating experience exciting and varied. Ready to experience the benefits of nutritious, seasonal food? Visit Curate Cafe and discover how delicious healthy eating can be. 40: The best exercise routine is one that you'll stick to consistently. Aim for a mix of cardiovascular activity and strength training throughout the week. This could mean taking brisk walks, joining a yoga class, or lifting weights, whatever you enjoy most. Start with manageable goals, like 30 minutes of movement three times per week, and gradually increase as your fitness improves. Remember to listen to your body and include rest days in your routine. Exercise should energize you, not exhaust you.
41: In your 45 minute follow-up visit, we'll review your food and movement journal together and go over any test results. We'll talk about any challenges you've faced in reaching your goals and work with you to set realistic, personalized SMART goals. If additional testing is needed, we'll discuss the next steps. Together, we'll outline a clear game plan and connect you with any other practitioners who may support your journey. You'll also receive gentle, practical recommendations, like getting morning sunlight, gentle exercise, and tips based on the five pillars of health: physical, mental, emotional, social, and spiritual well-being.

46: This 10-week clinically guided program helps you take back control of your health through lifestyle medicine. Whether you're dealing with a chronic diagnosis or just feeling ready for meaningful lifestyle changes, you'll receive weekly support and education from our practitioners in key areas like nutrition, movement, stress, sleep and more. With a focus on health sovereignty, this program gives you the tools, knowledge, and confidence to take charge of your own well-being. The goal is to help transition you into sustainable, long-term habits that support lasting vitality and well-being. After completion, many participants continue their journey through the Essential Series.
